_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): observability — structured JSON logging + filterable log viewer API. Pairs with comp-log-viewer. Stack-prod uses: feature-observability.
name: feature-observability
description: Structured observability: JSON-line logging with request-id + filterable GET /admin/logs. Pairs with log viewer UI.
notes: After applying: 1) call setup_logging() in main.py lifespan, 2) use log_structured() in middleware, 3) app.include_router(router) for logs, 4) frontend comp-log-viewer consumes GET {{ base_path }}/admin/logs.
